svg.text: Single-slit envelope on Young's double-slit fringes (d = 4a)
(a) One slit of width a: diffraction pattern
(b) Two such slits, centres a distance d = 4a apart
7 bright fringes fit in the central maximum:
the 4th-order fringe falls on the first single-slit minimum and is missing.
Each slit diffracts the light (envelope); the two slits interfere it (fringes inside the envelope).
